# CLI: Network

## get-nat-instance

Kind: Read.

Reads in `hcm-3` or `han-1` with IAM or service-account authentication.
Read-only profiles can run this command.

An omitted `--zone-id` requires a unique zone mapping for the selected region.

| Flag        | Type     | Required |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--nat-id`  | `string` | yes      |
| `--zone-id` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode network get-nat-instance --nat-id <nat-id>
```

## list-bandwidth-packages

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
greennode network list-bandwidth-packages
```
